text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors expressed frustration with crowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as distracting or lacking educational depth, with some visitors feeling the content did not adequately explain Theodore Roosevelt’s accomplishments. A few noted the physical design of certain interactive elements was not accessible for taller guests. While most reviews remain positive, these concerns about exhibit content and visitor experience suggest areas for review and improvement.

windows.60: Recent visitor reviews show that crowding, especially during school group visits, has negatively affected the experience, with some exhibits becoming difficult to access. Several guests expressed disappointment with the heavy reliance on AI-driven interactive exhibits, feeling these overshadowed substantive historical content and limited learning about Theodore Roosevelt’s presidency. Some visitors also noted issues with the design of AI kiosks, including accessibility problems for taller individuals. While many appreciated the architecture and landscape, concerns about parking and timed entry were mentioned. Overall, the average rating remains high, but attention to exhibit balance and crowd management could improve visitor satisfaction.
